limits: Explicit synthetic contact only; no historical war declarations or enemy army AI.
Injury/capture/death, historical hostile armies and remote non-recall/non-cancel commands are not yet implemented. Regroup60seconds/morale50 are trial coefficients.
Contact model and animation are engineering trials; numerical balance and nationwide battle performance are not accepted.
Fixed60fps capture is not a realtime performance benchmark.

Only the stated33 GPU checks were rerun: two repeated exercise cases, two military renewal cases, one cancellation result recovery, three cancellation cases, sender-unit evidence,held-open,deadline-closed,withdrawal and representative prior military/transport families, old military/combat, ground and three smokes. Other older cases were not rerun in this slice.

visual_review.method: Viewed seven regenerated actual Godot screenshots and four decoded video frames after hidden-label correction. Confirmed two episodes inherit casualties, actual retreats/regroups and returned command. Labels overlap in technical overview; final HUD/visibility acceptance is outside this stage. Fixed60fps footage is not realtime performance measurement.
